_comment: Stream server (ws-scrcpy) configuration. This file is the single place the
stream port is defined: ws-scrcpy reads it via WS_SCRCPY_CONFIG, and
server.py reads it to tell the dashboard where the stream server lives.
Change the port here only -- nothing else needs editing.
Why not 8000: ws-scrcpy's own default is 8000, which collides with a lot of
development tooling (Unreal Editor, Django, python -m http.server). On
Windows a process bound to 127.0.0.1:8000 wins over one bound to :: , so the
dashboard would silently frame that other app's error page instead of the
mirror. 8010 keeps the default clear of that.
